OFAC penalties by US state and year

File: ofac_state_penalties_2009_2025.csv
850 rows, covering 50 states and 17 years (2009 through 2025).

Columns
year: Enforcement year recorded in the source, matching the case date.
state: Full US state name.
average_penalty_2025_usd: Arithmetic mean of recorded monetary penalties
  in that state and year, in constant 2025 US dollars.
max_penalty_2025_usd: Largest recorded monetary penalty in that state and
  year, in constant 2025 US dollars. This is not a statutory maximum.

Population and treatment of missing data
Includes 201 positive monetary penalty/settlement records with an assigned
US state, Country_Name recorded as USA, and EntityType recorded as 1
(entity). This follows the existing project's US-entity map definition.
It does not independently establish ultimate ownership or incorporation
for each organization, and US-based subsidiaries can be included. A case
involving several respondents remains one record, with its full amount
assigned to the state in the source. These are respondent locations, not
necessarily locations of the underlying conduct.

Excludes individuals, mixed entity/individual respondents, and multinational
or non-USA country classifications (11 state-coded monetary records total).
Excludes DC, Puerto Rico, and Guam (four positive monetary records) because
the requested panel covers the 50 states.

An exact duplicate was removed from the full source before aggregation.
The existing project's derived-map correction assigns Wells Fargo Bank,
N.A. (March 30, 2023) to South Dakota. No other missing state was inferred.
No positive monetary record in the chosen US-entity population is left
without a state or identified territory after that correction.
Twelve state-coded findings of violation with no
recorded monetary amount were excluded from penalty averages.

Zero means no included monetary penalty in that state-year in this source.
It is a requested plotting convention, not an estimate of an average over
all businesses, and not proof that enforcement coverage is complete.
The source's latest recorded case date is December 16, 2025. No missing
monetary amount was converted into a zero-dollar case.

Inflation adjustment
Uses the OFAC project's saved annual BEA GDP implicit price deflator from
FRED, series A191RD3A086NBEA. Snapshot retrieved October 31, 2026; source
update dated September 30, 2026. Index units are 2017=100; output dollars
are expressed in 2025 purchasing power.

2025 dollars = nominal penalty * 128.893 / GDP deflator for the case year.

Each penalty is adjusted before averaging or taking its maximum. Final
values are rounded to cents. No inflation adjustment changes case counts.
https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/A191RD3A086NBEA
https://www.bea.gov/help/faq/513

Source
OFAC_MasterData_2003_2025_v7.dta in the OFAC Dataset - 2025 Updates project.
The original dataset and OFAC tool files were read without modification.
The package includes only the state-year aggregate table, not the underlying
case-level database. The preparation metadata retain the source hash and
deflator snapshot without local filesystem paths. Original package code is
MIT licensed; no ownership of US government source facts is claimed.

Bundled boundaries
us_states_sf.geojson is a 50-state subset of cb_2024_us_state_20m.shp,
US Census Bureau 2024 cartographic boundaries, 1:20,000,000, public domain.
https://www2.census.gov/geo/tiger/GENZ2024/shp/cb_2024_us_state_20m.zip
Retained NAME and STUSPS, transformed from EPSG:4269 to EPSG:4326, rounded
coordinates to six decimals. Islands are retained. This is a display dataset,
not a legal boundary or survey product. The default tutorial view shows the
contiguous states; all 50 remain in the embedded table and geometry.
